item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 10/May/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will form over the northern part of southern China this morning and move southwards gradually. It will linger over the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. There will be continuous heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over the region for a few days. A surge of the northeast monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong over the weekend. The weather will be windy with temperatures falling over the region. With the trough of low pressure departing from the coastal areas, showers will lessen gradually early to midweek next week.
